task:
Build a professional, concurrent Blackjack casino engine and real-time card counting probability oracle CLI in Go (Go 1.26+) from scratch with interactive ASCII card graphics. This is an empty project workspace.

Requirements:
1. Planning & Rules: In your initial plan, propose customizable casino rules (Vegas Strip, Atlantic City, European) including dealer hit/stand on soft 17, double after split, shoe deck counts (1-8), and blackjack payout ratios (3:2 vs 6:5).
2. State Machine: Implement a deterministic state machine supporting hit, stand, double down, split (multiple splits), insurance, and late surrender.
3. Card Counting & Strategy Oracle: Real-time card counting engine (Hi-Lo, KO, Omega II) calculating Running Count, True Count (adjusted for remaining decks), shoe penetration %, and an optimal Basic Strategy decision advisor overlay.
4. Monte Carlo Simulation: Provide a concurrent simulation engine running 10,000+ hands verifying player expected value (EV) and house edge against standard basic strategy tables.
5. Quality & TDD: Write idiomatic Go with table-driven tests (`*_test.go`), benchmark tests (`testing.B`), and zero warnings on `go vet ./...`. All unit tests (`go test -v ./...`) must pass with >= 90% test coverage.

Execution Rule: Proceed autonomously without asking for interactive confirmations between file creations until all files are written, `go build ./...` compiles with 0 errors, and `go test -v ./...` passes.
